description: Machine-readable redaction ground-truth schema for range-level object policy, visibility, and privacy requirements. The schema supports face objects now and license-plate objects in later milestones.
validation_rules: schema_version must be supported by the evaluator
object IDs must be unique within the file
frame ranges must be inclusive integer pairs with start <= end
frame ranges must be inside source_frame_count
policies must be redact, keep, or ignore
object_type must be face or license_plate
detector_scored_ranges and detector_ignore_ranges must not overlap for the same object
privacy_required_ranges and keep_clear_ranges must not overlap for the same object
bbox coordinates must be four numbers in xyxy order and must have positive area
source_video.sha256 must match the local source video when the source video is provided for validation
range-level truth must not be upgraded to per-frame box truth unless per-frame boxes actually exist
